note: The orchestrator's self-knowledge: which specialists it routes to, what each can actually do, and what inputs each requires. Keep in sync with the leaf packages (validated by tests/test_contract.py: roster keys must equal routing-table leaf keys).

specialists.name: application-aware-sirna-designer
capabilities: 11 siRNA application task frames (oncology, allele-selective, CNS, metabolic/GalNAc, systemic LNP...)
candidate generation via approved backends (OligoFormer) + RN.Ai/RNAiSpline efficacy endpoints
specificity (bowtie2 + seed/POTS/6merDB), structure (ViennaRNA 2.7.2), immune-hazard gates
frozen-gate ranking + computational selection records with property attribution
source-grounded parameter experimentation (context window, top-k, weights, thresholds)
boltzmann RNA workflow tools when authorized (BiomambaRna, rna-generation module)
specialists.read_scope: guard v2: only paths under explicit PARENT READ AUTHORIZATION markers in the assignment text

specialists.name: application-aware-grna-designer
capabilities: 13 CRISPR route classes (knockout, therapeutic, variant correction, base/prime editing, CRISPRi/a, epigenome, Cas13, diagnostics, libraries, plant, microbial)
native endpoint bindings (RS3, CRISPRon, PRIDICT2/DeepPrime ensemble, BEHive, RFcombined, CBE)
request-priority ranking (weights/vetoes/min-standards) + computational selection records
published-run audits against artifacts; parameter experimentation over runner settings
scope-routing verdicts without producing sequences (pathogen → review-only, microbial → conditional)
scope_limits: pathogen design review-only (parent approval cannot override)

specialists.name: rna-model-discovery
capabilities: registry-first reuse check (no rediscovery of EVIDENCE_REVIEWED+ capabilities)
candidate search under parent search/egress authorization (GitHub, HF, PubMed, EPMC, bioRxiv, Zenodo...)
per-candidate weights verdicts (WEIGHTS_PUBLIC / RESTRICTED / NO_WEIGHTS / VERIFIED_LOCAL)
evidence-attached multi-criteria ranking (never accuracy alone)
schema-validated ModelIntegrationSpec v1.1 emission; registry writes capped at DISCOVERED→EVIDENCE_REVIEWED→WEIGHTS_AVAILABLE

specialists.name: rna-model-execution
capabilities: isolated env + pristine clone at the spec commit; checkpoint checksum verification
REAL inference through official paths (7 interface classes; thin file-based adapters)
per-record outcomes preserving input→output mapping; output schema validation
ExecutionReport v1; registry INSTALLED→EXECUTION_TESTED→BENCHMARK_VALIDATED (PRODUCTION_APPROVED only with quoted parent directive)
resumable failure states with exact pending commands
scope_limits: never claims biological validity from mechanical success

capability_chain.description: How discovery and execution are used together when a required capability is missing
steps: 1. Registry check: capability at EVIDENCE_REVIEWED+ → reuse, route USE of the registered model
2. Gap + acquisition NOT pre-authorized → consolidate a missing-input request (sources, scope, destinations, budget) and stop
3. Gap + acquisition pre-authorized by the user's original assignment → DISCOVER directive with the full capability brief
4. Validated spec returned → (egress + destination still required from parent unless also pre-granted) → INSTALL+RUN directive
5. ExecutionReport + registry transitions verified by the orchestrator before the final consolidated report
